sel-e-d3.name: SEL-E.D₃
sel-e-d3.short: Antioxidant and nutritional support with vitamins E, D₃ and selenium.
sel-e-d3.summary: SEL-E.D₃ brings vitamin E, vitamin D₃ and selenium together in a liquid veterinary formulation. Its nutritional focus connects antioxidant support with the mineral and vitamin requirements of growing and breeding animals.
sel-e-d3.context: The product sits within the nutritional part of the Rigel range. It is relevant to conversations about vitamin and selenium intake, breeding-flock nutrition and the nutritional challenges that can accompany demanding production conditions.
features: Vitamin E and selenium are the formulation’s antioxidant-focused components.
Vitamin D₃ adds a vitamin component associated with calcium and phosphorus nutrition.
The presentation is intended for veterinary nutritional support rather than a substitute for a complete feeding programme.
sel-e-d3.species: Poultry, calves, sheep, goats and pigs are listed on the packaging.
sel-e-d3.route: The packaging identifies administration through drinking water.
sel-e-d3.dose: A mixing reference of 1 ml per 4 litres of water is shown in the supplied product material. It does not specify a complete species-specific course. Confirm the current product instructions and veterinarian’s plan before preparation.
planning: Review the existing feed and supplementation programme to account for total vitamin and selenium intake.
Identify the species, production stage and reason for supplementation.
Confirm the preparation instructions, treatment period and reliable access to water.

fr.short: Soutien nutritionnel et antioxydant : vitamines E, D₃ et sélénium.

fr.composition: Vitamines E et D₃, sélénium ; concentrations à confirmer.

v-plex.name: V-Plex A.D₃.E
v-plex.short: A liquid vitamin combination for nutritional support across production stages.
v-plex.summary: V-Plex A.D₃.E combines three vitamins in one veterinary nutritional presentation. The formulation’s focus spans vitamin A nutrition, vitamin D₃-related mineral metabolism and vitamin E’s antioxidant role.
v-plex.context: The product belongs to the vitamin-support range. A useful product discussion starts with the complete ration, the animal’s production stage and the practical reason for adding vitamins, rather than relying on a vitamin combination alone to address a health problem.
features: Vitamin A contributes the formulation’s epithelial-tissue and mucosal-nutrition focus.
Vitamin D₃ connects the product with calcium, phosphorus and skeletal-nutrition discussions.
Vitamin E provides an antioxidant nutritional component within the combination.
v-plex.species: Poultry, calves, sheep, goats and pigs are listed on the packaging.
v-plex.route: The presentation is labelled for administration through drinking water.
v-plex.dose: The supplied material shows a mixing reference of 1 ml per 4 litres of water. Frequency and course length are not fully specified. Confirm the exact product instructions and veterinary plan.
planning: Check existing vitamin sources in feed, premixes and other supplements.
Discuss the needs of growing, laying or breeding animals separately.
Record preparation dates and follow the exact product’s handling instructions.

fr.composition: Vitamines A, D₃ et E ; concentrations à confirmer.

apra-til.name: APRA-TIL
apra-til.short: A veterinary antibacterial presentation within the Rigel portfolio.
apra-til.summary: APRA-TIL is presented within Rigel’s antibacterial range. The supplied materials discuss poultry bacterial and respiratory-care contexts, including Mycoplasma-associated conditions, while the packaging presents a combination formulation.
apra-til.context: This product belongs in a veterinarian-led discussion about the suspected infection, the affected animals and the exact formulation available in the market. The supplied presentations do not consistently name the first antibacterial ingredient, so a confirmed current composition sheet is needed before product selection.

hepavon.name: HEPAVON
hepavon.short: A liver-focused nutritional formulation for metabolism and vitality.
hepavon.summary: HEPAVON broadens the Rigel range with a formulation centred on liver and metabolic support. Its product presentation combines choline, methionine and milk-thistle-related components with vitamins in a liquid veterinary supplement.
hepavon.context: The product is positioned around nutritional support for the liver, the organ’s metabolic role and the use of nutrients from feed. Discussions may include feed quality, changes in intake and the broader nutritional programme; a liver-support supplement does not replace investigation of suspected toxic exposure or illness.
features: A liver-focused addition to the nutritional portfolio.
Choline and methionine are named alongside milk-thistle extract and silymarin.
The product’s stated focus connects metabolism, digestion and nutritional vitality.

fr.composition: Choline, méthionine, extrait de chardon-marie, silymarine et vitamines ; spécification quantitative à confirmer.

eltrixe.name: ELTRIXE
eltrixe.short: A toxin-management and liver-support presentation for veterinary nutritional programmes.
eltrixe.summary: ELTRIXE is presented as a toxin-binder and hepatoprotectant within Rigel’s nutritional range. Its product positioning addresses feed-toxin management alongside liver support and the nutritional challenges associated with compromised feed quality.
eltrixe.context: The formulation belongs in a broader conversation about feed storage, ingredient quality and veterinary assessment of suspected mycotoxin exposure. The product description refers to toxin management, but it does not establish effectiveness against every toxin or replace testing, feed correction and a professionally supervised response.

minron.name: MINRON
minron.short: Essential minerals, trace elements and choline in a liquid feed supplement.
minron.summary: MINRON adds a mineral-focused formulation to the Rigel portfolio. The label names macro-minerals, trace elements, choline chloride and vitamin B₁₂ in a one-litre veterinary feed-supplement presentation.
minron.context: The product’s nutritional focus connects mineral intake with skeletal development and the needs of laying and growing birds. A useful assessment considers the complete ration, water and other mineral supplements before deciding whether additional supplementation is appropriate.

Trace elements include zinc, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt and selenium.
